textSegments: Compliance with the newest SFX12V V3.3
PS2 bracket for easy fitting into ATX case
Full protections OCP, OVP, SCP, OPP, OTP
SFX Pro Series is designed to the SFX power supply specification for high performance small form factor systems.
SFX Pro with sleeve fan will automatically adjust its speed according to the PSU’s temperature.
This will be excellent airflow and low noise to ensure that no matter what you are doing, the noise will always be minimized.
SFX Pro series comes with 80 PLUS bronze certified saves energy through its high efficiency up to 85%.
With the newest SFX12V V3.3 and the DC to DC structure, SFX Pro Series ensure you the outstanding conversion efficiency and offers reliability and stability.

FSP Group provides a full kinds of additional safety approvals to keep designs ahead of the changing regulations. FSP has upgraded the majority of power supplies to the new IEC 62368 standard for your gaming rigs.
The matt black coating and all black ribbon cables give your system a superior look rather other entry-level power supplies.
Adapts to your individual requirements, not only does it fit into cases with an SFX form factor, but can also be installed in a simple steps into normal ATX, Micro-ATX or Mini-ITX cases.
Universal Use, Wide Input Range Power Supply
Wide input voltage 100-240V, can ensure the stability of the system when the input voltage is not stable.
